description: This file defines authentication-related API endpoints for user registration, login, and profile retrieval using FastAPI. It leverages dependencies like database sessions and authentication services, and includes route handlers for register, login, and 'get current user' functionalities.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service handling authentication logic such as registration, login, and user retrieval.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration by creating a new user through the AuthService and returning user info.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Authenticates user and returns JWT token.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves current authenticated user's profile data.
